schema:
CREATE TABLE authors (
  address,
  au_fname,
  au_id,
  au_lname,
  city,
  contract,
  phone,
  state,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE discounts (
  discount,
  discounttype,
  highqty,
  lowqty,
  stor_id
);

CREATE TABLE employee (
  emp_id,
  fname,
  hire_date,
  job_id,
  job_lvl,
  lname,
  minit,
  pub_id
);

CREATE TABLE publishers (
  city,
  country,
  pub_id,
  pub_name,
  state
);

CREATE TABLE sales (
  ord_date,
  ord_num,
  payterms,
  qty,
  stor_id,
  title_id
);

CREATE TABLE stores (
  city,
  state,
  stor_address,
  stor_id,
  stor_name,
  zip
);

CREATE TABLE titles (
  advance,
  notes,
  price,
  pub_id,
  pubdate,
  royalty,
  title,
  title_id,
  type,
  ytd_sales
);
